body:
## Pensieve 0.6.4

### Fixed
- **Codex: a message sent while Codex works shows at once.** It is marked as waiting until Codex reads it, which Codex does when its current step ends.
- **Codex: "Compacting the conversation" instead of just "working".** When a conversation has filled Codex's context, Codex compacts it before reading your message. Your message now shows right away, and Pensieve says that Codex is compacting first.
- A message sent during a review goes in when the review ends. One that Codex stopped before reading stays visible, with **Send now**.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.4.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.4-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.4-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.4-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.4-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.4-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.4-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
